item.title: Fitbit Edge arrives to bridge the gap between Pixel Watch and Fitbit Air
item.description:
Succeeding the Charge 6, the lightweight aluminum tracker packs a 46% larger screen, upgraded GPS, and modular repairability

item.title: Polar Loop finally gets a bicep band to boost heart rate accuracy

item.description:
The new fitness tracker is expected to include notifications, GPS, an altimeter, up to seven days of battery life, and compatibility with both Android and iOS devices.

After Google's inadvertent reveal of a mysterious tracker in last month's Pixel promotion images, a detailed leak now appears to have revealed both the name and complete design of the device—Fitbit Edge.

item.title: Nuance Audio Plus hearing glasses arrive with longer battery and new styles
item.description:
EssilorLuxottica brand Nuance Audio has delivered the second generation of its open-ear hearing smart glasses—Nuance Audio Plus—designed for adults with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss.

Building on the initial release of Nuance Audio in early 2025, the updated device combines enhanced amplification algorithms, improved speech clarity in noisy environments, refined own-voice perception, and an extended battery life of about 10 hours.

item.title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 edges closer to a global rollout
item.description:
Xiaomi Smart Band 11 gets a brighter 2,000-nit AMOLED display, a slimmer design and a 21-day battery life.

Xiaomi has added the Smart Band 11 to its global website, showing off a brighter display, a slimmer build, and up to 21 days of battery life.

Google is rolling out Health Guardian features to Pixel Watch users, adding blood pressure, insulin resistance, and sleep breathing trends.

Google has begun rolling out blood pressure and insulin resistance trend reports after first teasing the Health Guardian features alongside the launch of the Pixel Watch 5.

item.title: The Beats 360 headphones arrive with interchangeable cushions for workouts
item.description:
Beats has officially unveiled the Beats 360, a new flagship pair of over-ear headphones that introduces modular physical customization to the brand's audio lineup.

Retailing at $349.99 / £299.95 and available now, the Beats 360 features interchangeable magnetic ear and headband cushions, allowing wearers to swap cushion materials and colors to suit different workouts, travel, or style preferences.

item.title: Peloton’s new treadmill trio brings a foldable design, AI form coaching, and Whoop integration
item.description:
Expanding its running push, Peloton introduces three new treadmills from £1,999 alongside Peloton IQ 'Run Analysis' and WHOOP wearable sync.

Peloton has announced a sweeping overhaul of its treadmill portfolio, introducing three new hardware models alongside an expanded suite of AI-driven coaching features powered by Peloton IQ.

item.title: Amazfit's T-Rex Dual Solar pairs dual-sided solar charging with AMOLED display
item.description:
Amazfit has officially introduced the T-Rex Dual Solar, with the latest iteration of its outdoor watch series featuring the industry’s first dual-sided solar-harvesting system.

Available now for $649.99, the new release helps users avoid the traditional trade-off in outdoor wearables: choosing between a high-resolution AMOLED display and multi-week battery life. With the T-Rex Dual Solar—at least in theory—you get both.

item.title: Huawei Watch D3 lands in UK & Europe with improved blood pressure tracking
item.description:
Huawei’s latest blood pressure smartwatch, the Watch D3, is now officially available across the UK and Europe following its initial reveal at the company's Munich launch event earlier this month.

Retailing at £399.99 / €399.99, the Watch D3 brings European CE-MDR medical certification and continuous blood pressure monitoring in a significantly sleeker form factor than the previous-gen Watch D2. It's now much more akin to the Watch Fit 5 series that debuted earlier this year.

item.title: These Garmin watches just got all-day fall detection and voice controls
item.description:
Garmin has announced a major wave of free software and feature updates across its smartwatch and cycling computer lineups, introducing new safety tools, voice interaction options, and adaptive training features.

The update brings fall detection to the Garmin Venu 4 smartwatch for the first time. Some premium devices from the brand already offer fall detection during workouts; however, the Venu 4 now lets users enable fall detection for all-day monitoring, too.
